verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Bookmarks feature. It fetches a URL's title, description, preview image and favicon and stores them as Properties on an Object. That is a basic web-capture flow, but it saves link metadata rather than clipping full page or article content and highlights from the browser. Missing for 10: an official browser extension or web clipper, full article or page content capture, highlight capture, a documented browser-to-notes flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
